Variants.Content: The development of Velites Skirmisher Screen exemplified the brutal pragmatism of ancient Mediterranean warfare. By coordinating specialized arms, standardized training, and flexible tactical subunits, commanders maximized shock power while adapting rapidly to changing battlefield crises.

Drill after drill in the blazing sun until the movements of Velites Skirmisher Screen became second nature! In the press of shield-to-shield combat, your training is the only thing keeping you breathing.

Mastery of Velites Skirmisher Screen separated victorious commanders from slaughtered fools. Rigorous doctrine and unrelenting discipline transform a mob of armed men into an invincible instrument of state will.
